title: [Bug]: The deepseek_v2.py function misses the output activation values ​​of the last layer when extracting hidden states.
author: wsb853529465

comments.author: VBS2004
comments.body: This looks already supported on main: the loop's pre-layer check is complemented by a post-loop capture right before the final norm — if self.end_layer in self.aux_hidden_state_layers: aux_hidden_states.append(hidden_states + residual) — so passing num_hidden_layers as a layer id yields the last layer's (pre-norm) output. This is documented in the Hidden State Extraction docs: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/speculative_decoding/extract_hidden_states/ ("It is possible to save the last-layer's output hidden states by passing num_hidden_layers as a layer id"). Which vLLM version/commit are you on? Note the proposed idx + 1 change would shift the capture semantics for existing EAGLE3 layer ids, and appending after the last layer inside the loop can capture a sequence-parallel-sharded tensor under TP — the post-loop placement after the all-gather handles that.
